name: Hollowpitch Carny

abilities.name: Slip Through the Crowd
abilities.description: The carny ignores difficult terrain, and opportunity attacks against it are made with disadvantage.

abilities.name: Fleet Agility (Bonus Action)
abilities.description: The carny takes the Dash or Disengage action.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The carny makes two attacks: one with its Hook Blade and one with its Carny's Call. It can replace one attack with a use of Stage Patter.

actions.name: Hook Blade
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (7d4 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Carny's Call
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Stage Patter
actions.description: One creature within 60 feet that can see or hear the carny's stage patter must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is charmed until the start of the carny's next turn, and while charmed this way, it must move toward the carny by the safest available route on its turn and can't take Reactions.

generation.userConcept: a carnival barker who talks you into standing still
